iOS 26-style app opening and closing animations for iPhone 8 on iOS 16. Upstream source by Stealth2115; rootless and rootful packages built by rajok. Revision rajok.2 fixes the iOS 16 spring settings class name and also applies response/damping through setters for cached presets. Original tuning is preserved. This is an approximation of iOS 26 animations, not its Metal rendering.

Upstream tuning: 1.50-second opening/closing duration, spring response 0.90, damping 0.60 and blur alpha 0.95. No Settings pane; tuning requires rebuilding.

Анимации открытия и закрытия приложений в стиле iOS 26. Сборки rootless и rootful для iPhone 8 на iOS 16. Автор исходников — Stealth2115, сборка пакетов — rajok. На устройстве пока не проверено.
ARM64 iPhone 8 / iOS 16. rajok.2 compatibility fix; wireless device verification pending.
